expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 protocol work will explore adding request identifiers for correlating messages, timestamps for recording message creation time, and extensible metadata for headers and tracing, while preserving the current Ping roundtrip behavior and allowing future protocol evolution.

Shipped: v2 Hello messages with the explicit v:2 envelope are now supported.
